playback_rendition_hint: IVS exposes only resolutions that actually exist on this broadcast. Seeing only Auto / 720p usually means ingest is capped at ~720p. Enable 1080p from the broadcaster: set webBroadcastQuality → 1080 in cdk.json and redeploy, or REACT_APP_WEB_BROADCAST_QUALITY=1080 in web-ui/.env, restart npm start, then start a new live session. OBS and other desktop encoders ignore that setting—set resolution there.
